identityAssessment: Independent topology decoding matches supplied bboxes. Hopewell 1492 to 1500 is explicitly rejected as historical chronology. Hopi outline is publicly flagged as grossly too broad into Baja direction. Zuni and Chumash remain distinct living communities; village abandonment and map endpoints are not extinction dates. Modern language samples and community-specific programs are explicitly dated/scoped.
